topic: Cofactor inverse-transpose normal matrix vs forward model-matrix transform
topic_zh: 余子式伴随逆转置法向矩阵与模型矩阵直乘对比
scope: Deterministic 3x3 cofactor adjugate normal transformation cof(M) = det(M)(M^-1)^T vs naive forward model-matrix multiplication M*n under non-uniform squash-and-stretch and shear, verifying tangent-normal orthogonality n'·t'=0 and cofactor cross-product vs Gauss-Jordan CPU solving. No neural 4DGS relighting execution.
